facts.business: IND-AGIV Commerce Limited provides multiple advanced audio-visual solutions.

auditor.name: M/s Mehta & Mehta
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Inability to verify Bangalore branch turnover; 2) Inventory valued at cost despite lower net realizable value; 3) Cash-in-hand of Rs 19,62,231 not physically verified; 4) Loans, advances, debtors, creditors subject to confirmation with no provision for bad debts; 5) Unsecured loans from related parties of Rs 12,45,32,187 accepted without compliance with Section 2(31); 6) Unrecovered impaired receivables of Rs 18,85,843 (EMD/Security deposits) and Rs 25,65,455 (Loans & Advances); 7) Default on working capital loan from NBFC; 8) Lack of internal financial controls over financial reporting. Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses, eroded net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and fully eroded net worth
Inability to verify Bangalore branch turnover
Inventory valuation at cost despite lower net realizable value
Cash-in-hand not physically verified by auditors
Loans, advances, debtors, creditors subject to confirmation with no bad debt provisions
Non-compliance in accepting unsecured loans from related parties (Rs 12.45 crore)
Unrecovered impaired receivables (EMD/Security deposits Rs 18.86 lakh, Loans & Advances Rs 25.65 lakh)
Default on working capital loan from NBFC
Lack of internal financial controls over financial reporting
facts.related_party_note: Company accepted unsecured loans from related parties — key managerial person, from Company and Others a sum of Rs. 12,45,32,187/- while accepting loans/deposits from Public, the company has not complied with the provisions of section 2(31) of the Companies Act, 2013.
